sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
काम एष क्रोध एष रजोगुणसमुद्भवः ।
महाशनो महापाप्मा विद्ध्येनमिह वैरिणम् ॥ ३-३७॥
iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
kāma eṣa krodha eṣa rajoguṇasamudbhavaḥ
mahāśano mahāpāpmā viddhyenamiha vairiṇam 3-37
translation: The Blessed Lord Said: It is desire, it is anger born of the active all-devouring, all-sinful; know this as the foe here (in this world) .
